latestVersion.changelog:
Warden Studio Deploy v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Enables safe, automated publishing of Community Agents to Warden Studio via browser automation.
- Guides user through preconditions, read-only validation, form drafting, and explicit approval for agent registration.
- Enforces strict safety: never request/store private keys, secrets, or credentials in chat.
- Summarizes all submission details before publishing; requires user confirmation to execute.
- Includes step-by-step troubleshooting guidance and verification after publishing.
- Designed for repeatable workflows and safe integration by other agents.
